meta.title: Trying it on
meta.description: This takes a few seconds. Keep browsing — we'll tell you the moment it's ready.

start.needsPhotoNote: A try-on works from one full-length photo of you. It takes about a minute to add.
start.needsConsent: Read how your photo is used
start.needsConsentNote: One short read before your first try-on, then you're set.
start.signIn: Sign in to try it on
start.signInNote: Browsing needs no account. Trying a piece on uses your own photo, so it does.

wait.title: Putting {garment} on your photo
wait.titleGeneric: Putting the piece on your photo

QUEUED.label: Getting started
QUEUED.body: Lining up your photo and the studio photo of the piece.

UPLOADING.label: Sending the pair over
UPLOADING.body: Your photo goes across encrypted, and the processing service deletes it straight afterwards.

GENERATING.label: Draping the piece
GENERATING.body: Matching the cut to your frame. This is the part that takes the longest.

FINISHING.label: Nearly there
FINISHING.body: Sharpening the result and saving it to your try-ons.

slow.title: Taking longer than usual — hang tight.
slow.body: It's still going. Carry on browsing and we'll tell you the moment it lands.

wait.keepBrowsingNote: Leaving this screen doesn't stop the try-on. It'll be waiting in your tray.

cancelled.title: Stopped
cancelled.description: Nothing was used from your monthly allowance. Start again whenever you like.

wait.caption: This is an approximate guide to help you shortlist. Fabric fall, embroidery detail and length will differ in person.

ready.title: Your try-on is ready
ready.description: Have a look, compare it with the studio photo, and say what you think.

tray.label: Your try-ons in progress
tray.heading: In progress and just finished
tray.empty: Nothing in progress. Pick a piece and try it on.

exhausted.title: You've used your try-ons this month
exhausted.description: Your shortlist is saved, and you can send an enquiry any time. Everything you've already tried on stays open and costs nothing to revisit.

budget.title: Our fitting room is at capacity today
budget.description: We'll email you when it's back. In the meantime the collection is open, and your shortlist is exactly where you left it.

failed.title: This try-on didn't finish
failed.noCharge: Nothing was used from your monthly allowance.

errors.title: The try-on didn't start
errors.description: Nothing was used from your monthly allowance. Try again, or pick a different piece.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Before your first try-on we need your go-ahead on how your photo is used.
errors.CONSENT_STALE: We've updated how we handle your photo. Have a read and confirm to carry on.
errors.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: You've used your try-ons this month — your shortlist is saved, and you can send an enquiry any time.
errors.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Our fitting room is at capacity today — we'll email you when it's back.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: You're going a bit fast. Give it a minute and try again.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email to start trying pieces on. We've sent you a link.
errors.PHOTO_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that photo. Pick another or add a new one.
errors.PHOTO_NOT_OWNED: We couldn't find that photo. Pick another or add a new one.
errors.PHOTO_BLOCKED_BY_MODERATION: Let's try a different photo — choose another and we'll carry on from here.
errors.GARMENT_NOT_FOUND: That piece is no longer listed. The rest of the collection is still here.
errors.GARMENT_NOT_PUBLISHED: This piece isn't available right now. Browse the rest of the collection.
errors.TEST_RENDER_REQUIRED: This piece isn't ready for try-on yet. Browse the rest of the collection.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT: That try-on is already running. Hang tight.
errors.JOB_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that try-on. Your finished ones are in your try-ons.
errors.UPSTREAM_NO_GARMENT_DETECTED: We're having trouble with this piece — we've been notified. Try another for now.
errors.UPSTREAM_INVALID_RESPONSE: We're having trouble with this piece — we've been notified. Try another for now.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: That photo didn't upload properly. Mind trying again?
errors.MODERATION_REJECTED: Let's try a different photo — choose another and we'll carry on from here.
errors.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: Taking longer than usual — hang tight.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: Taking longer than usual — hang tight.
errors.UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMITED: Taking longer than usual — hang tight.
errors.TRYON_PROVIDER_MISCONFIGURED: The fitting room is briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.CANCELLED: You stopped this try-on. Nothing was used from your monthly allowance.
errors.IP_BLOCKED: We can't complete that request. Contact the studio and we'll sort it out.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in to try a piece on.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and we'll bring you back here.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is on hold. Contact the studio and we'll sort it out.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. We'll pick this up when you're back.
errors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: We're briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The try-on didn't finish. Nothing was used from your allowance — try again.

photoPicker.title: Which photo should we use?
photoPicker.description: Your try-on is generated from this photo. Pick a different one any time.
photoPicker.noneNote: A try-on works from one full-length photo of you. It takes about a minute to add.
